title: Granular OAuth Scopes for Data Lineage Streaming
summary: The Data Lineage API now supports specific read-only and read-write OAuth scopes for the searchLineageStreaming method, enabling better security posture.
details: The searchLineageStreaming method under projects.locations has been updated to explicitly support the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datalineage.read-write and https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datalineage.readonly scopes. This allows developers to follow the principle of least privilege by using lineage-specific scopes rather than broader cloud-platform permissions.
